description: This is a PHP test class for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various API endpoints related to employee leave entitlements, including getOne and getAll functionalities, along with validation rules. The tests involve mocking dependencies such as services and DAOs, and verify the behavior of the API under different conditions.
external_files: OrangeHRM\Entity",  // Several entities like Employee, LeaveEntitlement, LeaveType, etc., in the project's entity namespace are referenced, but these are classes, not files per se, so perhaps most relevant external files are core API and framework classes, plus entities involved.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointTestCase, containing unit tests for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI, covering methods like getOne, getAll, validation rules, and exception handling.

methods.description: Tests that calling delete() on the API throws a not implemented exception.
